taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts C. lindheimeri at species rank; C. purpurea var. lindheimeri is a synonym.

target_zone_range.guardrail: Exact county evidence only; historical variety labels are reconciled to current accepted taxonomy.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with perennial habit and the upper leaves/bracts. Lindheimer's paintbrush has narrow leaves, upper leaves often 2–3-lobed, orange-red to scarlet bracts, and a glandular-hairy inflorescence. It is an Edwards Plateau endemic.
diagnostic_traits: lower leaves often unlobed, upper leaves commonly 2–3-lobed

comparisons.key_distinctions: Old sources often call this C. purpurea var. lindheimeri. Current Kew accepts C. lindheimeri as a full species. Use upper-leaf lobing, glandular inflorescence, perennial habit, and Edwards Plateau context.
